title: Triglyceride Measurement Protocol
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yw3fxgn

steps.title: Prepare 2X Reagent Solution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the powdered reagent using 25 ml of distilled water to create a 2X solution.

steps.title: Add Calibrator and Samples
steps.instruction: Dispense 3 μl of calibrator and sample into each respective well, ensuring no bubbles are introduced to avoid interference with the plate reader.

steps.title: Perform Initial PBS Reading
steps.instruction: Add 150 μl of PBS to each well and read the absorbance at 540 nm.

steps.title: Incubate with Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 150 μl of the prepared 2X reagent to each well and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Calculate Triglyceride Concentration
steps.instruction: Subtract blank readings from final readings and calculate unknown samples using the linear formula: (Sample Absorbance ÷ Calibrator Absorbance) × Calibrator Concentration.
